# Felinids
Small and mischievous cat-eared people.
## Diet
- Can eat raw meat. - Will get poisoned by Theobromine (Chocolate, Tea, Coffee) and Allicin (Onion, Garlic).
## Benefits
- Uses their claws and bite to do Piercing damage in melee. - Carries the Felinid accent, replacement vocalizations, and a felinid-specific speech style. - Can perform a short Gravity Jump using their ability action. - Move slightly faster than the average crewmember.
## Drawbacks
- Take modified damage per the Felinid damage modifier set — be careful in fights. - Cannot tolerate dog food. Hairballs and other felinid quirks may apply.
